_doc: T-416 (2026-11-20, hardened 2026-11-24): the pre-declared universe of the daily options snapshot archive (scripts/archive_options_snapshots.py). Owner approval 2026-11-20: start saving free daily option prices and implied volatility, so the project builds its own options history going forward (no free history with quotes exists). Every field without a leading underscore is read by the archiver; changing the list changes the coverage denominator, so review the diff.

_rules.expiries: Listed expiries strictly after the session, within horizon_days. Weekly = the LAST listed expiry of each calendar week (Friday, or Thursday when Friday is a holiday), so Mon-Thu dailies are skipped. Take the first n_weekly weeks, then the next n_monthly weeks that contain a third Friday (the standard monthly).
_rules.strikes: Strikes within [0.8 x min, 1.2 x max] of the session close and the delayed-SIP last trade (for an index, its proxy's), so an after-hours move cannot shift the band off the close. Only the standard root (root == symbol) is kept.
_rules.real_quote: Rule v2: quote stamped on the session (ET); bid > 0 and both sizes > 0 (a trade does not stand in for a bid); bid <= ask <= the no-arbitrage bound; ask >= intrinsic - 2 % of the underlying; spread <= max($0.10, 175 % of mid), i.e. ask <= 15 x bid (director ruling 2026-11-24: reject only pathological spreads); 1 % <= IV <= 500 % (waived when iv_expected is false). The flag is recomputable from the stored columns and no row is dropped because of it.
_rules.coverage: An underlying is covered when it has >= min_real_per_underlying real rows, they are >= min_real_share_per_underlying of its rows, >= min_returned_share_per_underlying of the contracts the listing named came back, and >= n_weekly expiries came back. Covered / declared < coverage_floor, or ANY required underlying not covered -> FAILED (rows kept). Zero real quotes -> FAILED, nothing written.
_rules.share_floor_measured: Real share under rule v2 (spread 175 % of mid) on two captures, both judged 49/49 OK: 2026-11-20 16:16 ET 0.880 overall (18,592 of 21,136), lowest 0.664 (ABBV), XSP 0.782 (0.884 under v1), fewest real rows 110 (NKE); 2026-11-24 12:45 ET 0.848 overall (21,047 of 24,810), lowest 0.569 (PG), XSP 0.912 (0.925 under v1), fewest real rows 127 (PFE). The 0.30 floor is below every one of them. Most common (bid, ask) pair: at most 2.7 % of a name's real rows (limit 25 %).
_rules.required: SPY, QQQ, IWM and XSP are required: the 90 % floor alone would let a wiped XSP pass inside a 48/49 day. The XSP market is already being pulled at the close (164 of 1,940 quotes zeroed at 15:59:59 ET on 2026-11-20).
_rules.acknowledged_gaps: {"YYYY-MM-DD": "reason"}: a session known to be lost for good. An unacknowledged gap alarms every day.

_universe_rationale: Index exposure: SPY, QQQ, IWM (the census's index-premium family O-1) plus XSP, the mini-SPX index option (European, cash-settled, Section 1256), which is the vehicle O-1 names and whose retail spreads are the binding unknown. Single names: 45 of the largest S&P 500 companies, all with weekly options, drawn from the 117 names that already have an earnings calendar in data/earnings/ so the earnings-options family E-1 can use this record. Picked by size and option liquidity with a sector spread; BRK.B is left out because its option root (BRKB) differs from its stock symbol.

_excluded.SPX: Served on the indicative feed, but carries no implied vol or greeks (Alpaca has no index level), and the SPX root is the AM-settled monthly: its quotes on 2026-11-20 were stamped 2026-11-19 (it stops trading the day before expiry). XSP covers the same index at a retail size.
_excluded.SPXW: Served (quotes fresh on 2026-11-20) but no implied vol or greeks; 10x XSP's notional, beyond the owner's size; ~13k contracts in 60 days within the band, which would more than double the daily bytes.
_excluded.opra: The OPRA feed returns HTTP 403 'OPRA agreement is not signed' on this account (2026-11-20); only the indicative feed is free.
